findings.claim: The --path help and its reference row still say --path is used "only when stdin names no usable folder" for formats other than opencode, but the new code makes an explicit --path win and never reads stdin for every format, as the same help's own "Where the repository comes from" paragraph says. The two halves of one help screen now disagree.

README.md still says APM installs "for Claude Code a hook that runs kmctl summary nudge after each tool call"; Antigravity now gets the PostToolUse hook from APM and OpenCode gets the nudge from the plugin patch writes, so the sentence is now false by omission.
